reproducer:
import json, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
root = Path.cwd()
evidence = json.loads((root / 'docs/performance/2026-09-24-origin-cache-prototypes.json').read_text())
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='moondsp-origin-replay-') as directory:
    target = Path(directory)
    for package in ['identity', 'pattern', 'song', 'mini']:
        shutil.copytree(root / package, target / package)
    (target / 'pattern/pattern_doc.mbt').write_text(evidence['baseline_source'])
    for package in ['pattern', 'song', 'mini']:
        shutil.copytree(target / package, target / (package + '_baseline'))
    (target / 'moon.mod').write_text(evidence['module_manifest'])
    (target / '.mooncakes').symlink_to(root / '.mooncakes', target_is_directory=True)
    for name, content in evidence['paired_files'].items():
        file = target / name
        file.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        file.write_text(content)
    subprocess.run(['patch', '--batch', '-p1'], input=evidence['variants']['sparse']['patch'], text=True, cwd=target, check=True)
    scope = 'trial_compare/representative_benchmark.mbt' if '--smoke' in sys.argv else 'trial_compare'
    subprocess.run(['env', 'NEW_MOON_MOD=0', 'moon', 'bench', scope, '--target', 'wasm-gc', '--release', '--no-parallelize'], cwd=target, check=True)
method: Four separately parsed documents rotate per group; parse and event/path/binding-depth parity are outside timing. Each timed invocation uses fresh lowering caches. Release wasm-gc, serial execution. Screening in separate invocations; sparse rechecked with baseline in the same compiled module/process, per-scenario AB and BA orders.

decision: Integrate sparse first-entry/secondary-index cache only. 128/512-path preparation improves in both paired orders; accept measured 32-path overhead and about 1% overhead on representative nested source. Reject forward sharing, cold reversal memoization, global composite index and per-context fingerprint parameter variants.
limitations: No dynamic allocation-byte, retained-heap or GC-pause measurements.
Compiler stress cases do not establish browser playback admission.
Serial hashes select buckets only; full context and generation-token equality remain authoritative. Collisions retain linear bucket search.
Whole-pattern context specialization and repeated dependency-token work remain. No proof of worst-case preparation bounds or whole-render allocation freedom.
